message:
fix(web): sort done by completion time and confirm pending drops (#1247) (#1323)

fix(web): disambiguate done-gate dismiss and i18n get<T> scan (#1247)

Dismiss is 关闭; canceled outcome is 已取消 so Playwright name match
no longer collides. api.get<WireTodo> became a GetKeyword JSX false
positive for i18n-coverage — use type assertion instead.

fix(shared): stream thinking_delta into the session (#1308) (#1328)

fix(1308): make resetLive a one-shot clear

Bugbot: resetLive stayed on the activity report and in hub
lastActivity, so the 5s noteEvent resend and catch-up could replay it
and wipe thinking that had already started streaming after the retry.

Daemon strips resetLive from base/current right after the emit.
Hub still publishes the live event with the bit (client clears once),
but stores lastActivity without it so catch-up cannot clear again.

fix(ci): single-use helper gate 只标新增函数，白名单按名字匹配 (#1562)

* fix(ci): single-use helper gate flags only newly declared functions, allowlist by path and name

closes #1561

* docs(verify): 1561 before/after gate output

fix: 测试清掉 git 钩子注入的环境变量，防止改写真实仓库配置 (#1581)

fix(web): tool-result echo pairing trims both sides (#1584)

* fix(web): tool-result echo pairing trims both sides

pi uploads each tool result as a role=system row. The transcript mapper pairs
that row with its toolcall to hide it, but trimmed only the lookup side, so any
output ending in a newline missed the pair and rendered in full as a centered
note. On build 01a16843 (todo #82) 38 of 45 echoes leaked this way.

* docs(verify): before screenshot of the leaked tool echoes on todo #82

fix(ci): npm-command-gate checks PUBLISHED_PACKAGES table (#1585)

* fix(ci): npm-command-gate checks PUBLISHED_PACKAGES; dialog comment drops unpublished package name

* fix(web): drop create-machine-dialog header comment instead of rewriting it
fix(scripts): migrate script restores a dirty pnpm-lock.yaml before checkout (#1592)

fix(daemon): worktree add/remove get a checkout-sized timeout (#1593)

worktree add and remove write every tracked file (8507 here) but ran under the
30s metadata budget. On a loaded Mac the checkout measured 45s, so todo #82's
builds were SIGTERMed with 'Could not write new index file'.

fix(scripts): migrate script stops each systemd unit separately (#1597)

fix(scripts): migrate script stops each systemd unit separately and fails if the old daemon survives
fix(scripts): migrate script rebuilds apps/web on the Mac (#1598)

fix(prepush): take a heavy slot when prepush-vitest runs directly (#1703)

Direct runs of scripts/prepush-vitest.mjs acquire a machine-wide heavy
slot before starting vitest and release it when the child finishes; runs
nested under pnpm prepush keep reusing the inherited CAIRN_HEAVY_SLOT /
CAIRN_HEAVY_SLOT_OWNER lease, and CI keeps its queue exemption.
docs/spec/19 documents the covered entry point and
docs/lessons/1703-direct-vitest-skipped-slot.md records the incident
with its negative control.

Rebased onto 5adc14e4 (origin/main). The base movement since the
reviewed head is main's 1786/1828/2009 commits; the reviewed patch is
unchanged, and both sides' lesson entries are kept as separate files:
docs/lessons/1626-single-use-helper-gate-red.md and the 1786/1828
entries from main, docs/lessons/1703-direct-vitest-skipped-slot.md from
this PR.

Blocking findings in the latest review-gate comment (595a1367): none, a
carried-over PASS for the same patch. Failing required checks: none,
check / pack-smoke / e2e-gate / pr-evidence all pass on run 40549699217.

Evidence: docs/verify/1703/cairn-1703-reconcile-evidence/ — original
script negative control (red.log), direct and inherited-lease focus
tests (green.log), 44-test regression run (regression.log), full
prepush (prepush.log).
Evidence: post-rebase re-verification on 5adc14e4 — node --test
scripts/heavy-slots.test.mjs scripts/prepush.test.mjs
scripts/english-only-gate.test.mjs: 44 pass, 0 fail; node
scripts/lessons-ledger-gate.mjs, node scripts/english-only-gate.mjs,
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm spec:parse: pass; direct
node scripts/prepush-vitest.mjs logs "[heavy-slots] acquired slot 1/2"
and exits 0.
